hurried: how old is the baby in weeks and what milestones
fuller: The age shows at the top in weeks, worked out from the birth date I can change. Below it, a box to add a milestone and a list of them, newest first.

hurried: pushups 30 day challenge counter
fuller: 30 days of push ups from a start day I can change. Each day's target is 10 plus the day number, and the day and target show in big figures.

hurried: fuel milage per litr
fuller: Petrol costs are going up, so I need to know how many kilometres per litre the car is getting, from the last fill against the first. A box adds each fill with its litres, odometer and price.

hurried: tailr shop customers, measurements, orders, fabric
fuller: Each customer has a chest, waist and sleeve measure, a phone number, and orders with a due date and a ready tick. Fabric meters are kept in a list of their own.

hurried: chete meals count this week
fuller: The top shows a drawing of circles, one for each cheat meal I log, against a count set to 10. A big number shows the current day streak of cheat meals I have had. Tap the drawing to log one.

hurried: exam questions with answers and score
fuller: Questions in a bank, each with A, B and C answers and a topic. I pick an answer and get a running score of how many I got right. The exam date can be changed.

hurried: egg sales today money pls
fuller: A list of egg sales, each with its eggs and amount, a box to add a sale, and a bar chart of the money from sales on each day of the last week, with today's total big.

hurried: three things i am grateful for each day
fuller: Three things I am grateful for each day, written in three boxes, with a count of nights written so far and a daily reminder to write them, all in a list by day I can edit.

hurried: loan installments, price down rate and months
fuller: Boxes for price, down payment, months and rate, with the total I would pay shown below them. The amount borrowed is worked out from price minus down payment.

hurried: pool score dad vs son, play to 7
fuller: At the top the Dad and Son scores with a plus one button for each side, and a play to target of 7 that I can change.

hurried: water ml today, streak, average
fuller: Today's water total in ml shows big at the top, with my day streak and 30 day average beside it, and a way to log each drink.

hurried: kids chores done today count
fuller: Our kids keep forgetting chores, so the count of chores done today sits at the top out of the total, with a tick for each chore and a list I can edit.

hurried: electricity units used this month price per unit
fuller: 20 per unit is my price, and I can change it. Units used this month show as a number worked out from my meter readings, with a list of readings I can tap to fix.

hurried: bee hives strength, queen and honey
fuller: Each hive is listed by name with its strength from 1 to 5, a yes or no for the queen, and honey in kg if I collect some. Each inspection is a new entry.

hurried: protein grams per meal, daily heat map
fuller: It is for my protein, so I want a 70 day heat map of grams, a box to add each meal and a list to fix.

hurried: i keep forgetting to post my reels so i want a count
fuller: I want a drawing of circles that fills as I add each post toward a target of three, and a notice when I reach it, so I stay on track with my reels.

hurried: baby milk ml today, feeds streak pls
fuller: A big day streak at the top, a box to add each feed in millilitres, and a bar chart of the last seven days with a list I can tap to fix.

hurried: how much does each customer owe for milk?
fuller: Each customer has a rate per litre, a list of deliveries in litres, and a list of payments, so I can see the balance owed to me for milk.

hurried: which tools are running low in my shed
fuller: It is for my tool shed, so I see how many tools are running low at the top, then each tool with its quantity and kind of Daily, Weekly or Rare.

hurried: daily spend average last 30 days and today
fuller: I keep overspending, so I want my average spend over the last 30 days in a big number, today's total against a daily limit of 2000 I can change, and a list to fix mistakes.

hurried: next prayer time and which one
fuller: The next prayer shows in big letters at the top, worked out from the times I have entered. Below it, the list of all my prayer times with their names so I can edit any of them.

hurried: books finished this year and ratings pls
fuller: It is for my reading, so I see how many books I finished this year, a box to add a new book with its author and pages, and each finish with a rating from 1 to 5.

hurried: bmi from my weight and height pls
fuller: Two boxes at the top, one for weight in kg and one for height in cm. Your BMI sits below them and is worked out from both. The starting values are 70 kg and 170 cm.

hurried: office days this month, 8 is the goal
fuller: A month calendar where I tap a day to mark it as an office day, with arrows to move between months. The number of office days a month can be set, starting at 8.

hurried: late meals this week after my cutoff hour
fuller: 9 pm is my latest hour to eat, and I can change it. Each meal I log after that time is counted in late meals this week, with a list of meals to fix.

hurried: bills i still need to pay with due dates
fuller: I always forget bills until they are late, so I need a list of unpaid bills sorted by due date, each with its name, amount, due date and a tick box once paid.

hurried: tea timer steeping cups counter
fuller: 4 minutes is my steep time, and I can change it. A countdown labelled Steep adds a steep when it ends and says Steep done. A count of steeps today sits beside it.

hurried: contacts not seen in a while
fuller: I lose touch with people, so I want days since my last contact with each person at the top, a count of contacts this month, and a box to add someone new with a role.

hurried: how many weeks in a row have i read kahf
fuller: It is for my Jummah reading, so I see a button that marks Surah Kahf for this week, and the number of weeks in a row I have kept it.

hurried: how many diapers today, wet or dirty?
fuller: Changes need logging, so each diaper is added with one tap on Wet, Dirty or Both. A count for today sits at the top, with a bar chart of the last seven days.

hurried: when is next car service due km
fuller: I forget the car service, so I want the next service km worked out from the last one, the current km I can change, and a list of past services with the day, garage and cost.

hurried: gym visits this week and reset today
fuller: It is for my gym habit, so I see how many visits I have made today against a target of 3 that I can change. A Reset today button clears the day if I log by mistake.

hurried: how long have i brushed my teeth today?
fuller: A two minute countdown labelled Brush that adds a brush when it ends and says Brush done, a count of brushes today, and a list of brushes with notes.

hurried: how many words did i write today?
fuller: 3500 words is my daily goal, with a progress bar for today and a big number for this week's total, plus a box to add each session.

hurried: prayer notes this month and my bar chart
fuller: It is for my duas: a big number for this month, a bar chart of the last seven days, and a box to add each dua with its title and text.

hurried: evening routine steps done today
fuller: Each evening step is a name with a tick box, so I can see what is done. A count at the top shows how many steps are done today out of the total.

hurried: ramadan roza kept and missed, with reasons
fuller: Each day has its sehri and iftar times, plus a Done or Missed status. A count shows how many roza I have kept and how many I missed. A box lets me say why I missed one.

hurried: baby temp latest and history
fuller: Degrees between 34 and 42 can be logged, and the latest reading shows big on the Add page, with a line chart of the last 90 days on the Charts page.

hurried: dots board red or blue, who is next
fuller: It is for our dots game, so I can tap 1 to 25 to place a red or blue dot. The board shows how many red and blue dots there are and whose turn is next.

hurried: first aid supplies running low, count
fuller: Low supplies get forgotten in a kit, so the running low count sits at the top, then each supply with its quantity, its low level of 3 and whether it is for home, work or other.

hurried: sabzi kg bought vs sold per item pls
fuller: I am losing track of greens, so for each vegetable I see the kg bought and the kg sold, and the difference shows what is left in stock.

hurried: my pet weight over time
fuller: It is for my pet, so I want an Add page to log its weight in kg with a note, and a Charts page with a list by day that I can fix.

hurried: days since last dig in garden
fuller: On the Add page, a big number shows the days since my last dig, another shows the average gap, and a box logs each job by bed and task. A Charts page shows the history.

hurried: study hours today out of 4 with quick buttons
fuller: A drawing of rectangles fills up as I study, with the total hours of study today shown as hours of 4. Quick buttons add study time in one tap.

hurried: customers loyalty card numbers and phones
fuller: I keep losing customers' details, so I need each customer's name, phone and card number in one list, with a swipe to remove and a tap to edit anyone. Each entry is easy to find.

hurried: ramadan planner with sehri iftar and taraweeh
fuller: It is for my Ramadan days, so each day has a date, sehri and iftar times, a yes or no for roza kept, and a taraweeh count. A box lets me add days.

hurried: how many calls to mom today?
fuller: I forget to call mum, so a drawing of circles counts my calls today against a target of 3 I can change, and each tap adds a call to the count.

hurried: stairs this week and average, floors
fuller: I cannot tell how much I climb, so I want the floors I have climbed this week as a big number, a 30 day average beside it, and a box to add each climb.

hurried: match runs and wickets so far in cricket
fuller: The average runs per match shows as text, with the number of matches, total runs and total wickets, and a list of matches I can edit.

hurried: nursng feeds, which side next
fuller: It is for nursing my baby, so the app tells me the next side to start on, which is the opposite of the latest side, and shows how many feeds today and minutes for each one.
